task: Close the Cloudflare API-coverage allowlist: proxy all 16 remaining in-surface CF endpoints so every op in scripts/api-coverage/fixtures/cloudflare.ops.json is covered by a real Hono route with its own IAM action, and the cloudflare provider allowlist is empty. The binding spec - the exact 16 ops, their target IAM action names, the per-op touchpoint checklist, the hard rules and the golden references to copy - is docs/plans/2026-08-10-cf-coverage-completion.md. Read it first and follow it exactly. Work service by service (kv, workers, queues, dns, hyperdrive), keeping typecheck/lint/tests green as you go, and regenerate the coverage snapshot with 'bun run api-coverage:write' when routes change.
rules: docs/plans/2026-08-10-cf-coverage-completion.md is the spec and is READ-ONLY. If it is wrong, stop and say so in your final message instead of editing it.
Never edit test/api-coverage.test.ts, .pi/harness.json, or anything under .pi/ - they are the loop machinery that judges this work.
Never hand-edit the covered flags in scripts/api-coverage/fixtures/cloudflare.ops.json. Regenerate with 'bun run api-coverage:write'.
Every new route needs BOTH an allow test (policy grants the action, request reaches the mocked upstream) and a deny test (403 without the action).
Copy the nearest sibling handler's shape exactly. No new abstractions, no helper extraction, no refactoring of existing routes.
Run 'bun run lint:fix' before you finish - prettier is a gate (tabs, single quotes, width 140).
Do not run git commit, git reset, git checkout, git stash or any other command that moves git refs.

cli/policy-wizard.ts and dashboard/src/lib/policy-templates.ts are deliberately CURATED short lists, not full action enumerations - do not add the new actions there. The full enumerations that must stay complete are dashboard/src/components/PolicyBuilder.tsx and the action lists in docs/GUIDE.md.

sensors.name: typecheck
sensors.hint: tsc failed - fix the types in the files you touched; do not use 'any' to silence it

sensors.name: lint
sensors.hint: prettier --check failed. Run 'bun run lint:fix' (tabs, single quotes, width 140)

sensors.name: coverage-invariant
sensors.hint: the committed snapshot disagrees with the real routes, or an allowlist entry is now covered. Run 'bun run api-coverage:write' and delete the allowlist entry for any op you just proxied

sensors.name: no-stubs
sensors.canary: printf '\nfunction __canary() { throw new Error("not implemented"); }\n' >> src/cf/queues/routes.ts
sensors.hint: a stubbed or 501 route is not an implementation - forward the request with a real IAM action like its siblings do

sensors.name: secrets
sensors.hint: a credential-shaped string was committed to the tree. Move it to env or use an obviously-fake fixture value; do not disable the scanner

sensors.name: test
sensors.hint: the suite is red. Fix the code, never the assertion

sensors.name: test-count-floor
sensors.cmd: test "$(bun run test 2>&1 | rg -o 'Tests +([0-9]+) passed' -r '$1' | tail -1)" -ge 1367
sensors.hint: 16 new routes need at least 16 new tests (the spec requires an allow AND a deny test per route). The floor is 1367 passing tests

sensors.name: build
sensors.hint: the dashboard or CLI build broke - most likely a syntax error in the PolicyBuilder edit

sensors.name: policybuilder-action-parity
sensors.cmd: test -z "$(for a in $(rg -o "^\t\| '[a-z0-9_]+:[a-z0-9_]+'" src/cf/*/operations.ts -r '$0' | sed "s/.*'\(.*\)'/\1/" | sort -u); do rg -qF "$a" dashboard/src/components/PolicyBuilder.tsx || echo "$a"; done)"
sensors.hint: every CF IAM action must be selectable in dashboard/src/components/PolicyBuilder.tsx - add the missing action to its service group with a label and description

sensors.name: guide-action-parity
sensors.cmd: test -z "$(for a in $(rg -o "^\t\| '[a-z0-9_]+:[a-z0-9_]+'" src/cf/*/operations.ts -r '$0' | sed "s/.*'\(.*\)'/\1/" | sort -u); do rg -qF "$a" docs/GUIDE.md || echo "$a"; done)"
sensors.hint: every CF IAM action must appear in the service action list in docs/GUIDE.md

sensors.name: doc-count-consistency
sensors.cmd: CFCOV=$(jq '[.[]|select(.covered)]|length' scripts/api-coverage/fixtures/cloudflare.ops.json); CFAL=$(bun -e 'const m = await import("./scripts/api-coverage/providers/cloudflare.ts"); console.log(Object.keys(m.cloudflareProvider.allowlist ?? {}).length)' | tail -1); test -z "$(rg -o --no-filename '[0-9]+ covered' AGENTS.md scripts/api-coverage/README.md | grep -oE '^[0-9]+' | sort -u | grep -vx "$CFCOV")" && test -z "$(rg -o --no-filename '[0-9]+ (deliberately )?allowlisted' AGENTS.md scripts/api-coverage/README.md | grep -oE '^[0-9]+' | sort -u | grep -vx "$CFAL")"
sensors.hint: a covered/allowlisted count stated in AGENTS.md or scripts/api-coverage/README.md contradicts the real numbers. Derive them from the fixture and the provider allowlist, then update every occurrence

sensors.name: cf-all-ops-covered
sensors.hint: some in-surface CF ops still have no route. Run 'bun run check:api-coverage' to list them, add the route + IAM action, then 'bun run api-coverage:write'

sensors.name: cf-allowlist-empty
sensors.hint: delete the allowlist entry in scripts/api-coverage/providers/cloudflare.ts for every op you proxied - the goal is an empty allowlist

sensors.name: drift
sensors.hint: the committed snapshot is stale or an op is uncovered and not allowlisted. Run 'bun run api-coverage:write' after any routing change

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: bun ~/.pi/agent/skills/self-correcting-loop/judge.ts --base HEAD --model claude-opus-5 --spec 'The 16 previously-allowlisted Cloudflare API endpoints listed in docs/plans/2026-08-10-cf-coverage-completion.md are now proxied: each has a real Hono route in the right src/cf/<svc>/routes.ts, a dedicated IAM action in that service operations.ts action union (except the legacy KV bulk DELETE, which reuses kv:bulk_delete), the header-comment route table updated, the action selectable in dashboard/src/components/PolicyBuilder.tsx and listed in docs/GUIDE.md, an allow test AND a 403 deny test, the allowlist entry deleted, and the snapshot regenerated. docs/SECURITY.md gains a note that workers:prepare_live_tail and hyperdrive:create_database_signature hand the caller an off-gateway, unaudited capability.' --rubric 'Reject stubs, 501 placeholders, or a route that forwards without an IAM action. Reject a route that reuses an unrelated existing action instead of the one the spec names. Reject any new abstraction, helper extraction or refactor of existing routes - the change must copy the sibling handler idiom. Reject weakened, skipped or deleted tests, and reject a route tested only on the happy path. Reject stale counts in AGENTS.md or scripts/api-coverage/README.md. Ignore .pi/** and docs/plans/** - those are loop machinery and spec, not part of the change.'
sensors.hint: the reviewer rejected the change - address each finding it names
